tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search long-term and holiday rentals in North Goa, India (Morjim, Arambol, Mandrem, Ashwem, Siolim...). Pass the user's request as plain text in `query`, in any language (e.g. '2BHK in Mandrem under 60k for January, quiet, with AC'), and/or explicit filters; explicit filters win. Returns up to 10 pl

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Full details of one place by its id from search_properties: prices by season, distance to the beach, amenities, description, photos, owner confirmation date and the Telegram link. Copy the result's complete `price_context` object into this call to keep the same price context. Unknown requested-perio

tools.name: get_locations
tools.description: Areas of North Goa we have places in and property types, with counts. Call it first to learn valid `location` and `type` values. Read-only.

tools.name: compare_properties
tools.description: Compare 2-5 places side by side by their ids from search_properties. Returns full details of each, a summary (cheapest per month and per night, closest to the beach, most bedrooms, most recently confirmed by the owner) and which amenities they share or only one has. Pass Copy `price_context` from th
